name: astro-plugins
description: Various astro plugins such as astro-htmlnano to minify Astro files with HTMLNano and CSSNano
author: Amin Yahyaabadi

scripts.bump: ncu -u -x 'eslint' && turbo run bump && bun update
scripts.doc: bun '--filter=./packages/*' run doc && bun run format
scripts.test.astro5.htmlnano: cd test/astro5 && cross-env NODE_ENV=production TEST=htmlnano bun run build
scripts.test.astro5.posthtml: cd test/astro5 && cross-env NODE_ENV=production TEST=posthtml bun run build
scripts.test.astro6.htmlnano: cd test/astro6 && cross-env NODE_ENV=production TEST=htmlnano bun run build
scripts.test.astro6.posthtml: cd test/astro6 && cross-env NODE_ENV=production TEST=posthtml bun run build
